name: Half day
note: The unit the tracker books. A day split in two.

name: Month grid
note: Four cells. Three booked and one open.
body: <rect x="10" y="10" width="20" height="20" rx="6" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="34" y="10" width="20" height="20" rx="6" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="10" y="34" width="20" height="20" rx="6" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="34" y="34" width="20" height="20" rx="6" fill="#FF4D06"/>

name: Progress ring
note: The month against its target. The gap is what is left.
body: <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="7" opacity=".28"/><path d="M32 12a20 20 0 1 1-17.32 10" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>

name: Connected dots
note: The 4flow connected shape set on a track.
body: <rect x="3" y="29.5" width="58" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="currentColor" opacity=".3"/><circle cx="25" cy="32" r="12" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="41" cy="32" r="12" fill="#FF4D06"/>

name: Stopwatch
note: Time being measured rather than time passing.
body: <rect x="28" y="7" width="8" height="10" rx="3" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="32" cy="36" r="19" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M32 36 42 27" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

name: Split bars
note: The month divided across cost centres.
body: <rect x="11" y="15" width="42" height="10" rx="5" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="11" y="27" width="26" height="10" rx="5" fill="#FF4D06"/><rect x="11" y="39" width="34" height="10" rx="5" fill="currentColor"/>

name: Monogram T
note: The letter built from a stem and a track.
body: <rect x="26.5" y="14" width="11" height="38" rx="5.5" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="10" y="14" width="44" height="11" rx="5.5" fill="#FF4D06"/>

name: Day done
note: One day closed. The clearest mark at a small size.
body: <path d="M8 22a14 14 0 0 1 14-14h20a14 14 0 0 1 14 14v20a14 14 0 0 1-14 14H22A14 14 0 0 1 8 42Z" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M20 33 28.5 41.5 44 24" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

name: Hourglass
note: Time running out. The month has a deadline.
body: <rect x="13" y="7" width="38" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M17 14h30L34.2 31a2.7 2.7 0 0 1-4.4 0Z" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M17 50h30L34.2 33a2.7 2.7 0 0 0-4.4 0Z" fill="#FF4D06"/><rect x="13" y="50" width="38" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="currentColor"/>

name: Marked day
note: A calendar with the day you are on picked out.
body: <rect x="19" y="6" width="7" height="13" rx="3.5" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="38" y="6" width="7" height="13" rx="3.5" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="8" y="14" width="48" height="42" rx="11" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="33" y="33" width="13" height="13" rx="4" fill="#FF4D06"/>

name: Bubbles
note: The mark already running across the five mockups.
body: <circle cx="23.3" cy="23.3" r="17.3" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="40.7" cy="40.7" r="17.3" fill="#FF4D06"/>

name: Bubble stopwatch
note: The same two bubbles. The one behind becomes the dial.
body: <rect x="20" y="5" width="8" height="8" rx="4" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="24" cy="26" r="16" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M24 26 35 20" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="40" cy="42" r="16" fill="#FF4D06"/>

name: Lane nodes
note: A route with its stops. The leading node is where you are.
body: <rect x="14" y="29.5" width="34" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="14" cy="32" r="6" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="31" cy="32" r="6" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="48" cy="32" r="9" fill="#FF4D06"/>

name: Chevrons
note: The progression indicator the site uses. Forward and on time.
body: <path d="M16 15 32 32 16 49" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M32 15 48 32 32 49" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

name: Flow arc
note: The flow curve with the node it is heading for.
body: <path d="M10 48Q10 16 42 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="44" cy="16" r="11" fill="#FF4D06"/>

name: Half day stacked
note: Half day split the way the grid stacks it. Two rows to a day.

name: Three bubbles
note: Bubbles carried to three. End to end rather than a pair.
body: <circle cx="19" cy="19" r="13" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="32" cy="32" r="13" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="45" cy="45" r="13" fill="#FF4D06"/>

name: Ring check
note: Progress ring crossed with Day done. The month closed.
body: <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="7"/><path d="M22 32 29 39 42 25" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

name: Bubble stopwatch reversed
note: The dial moved to the front bubble. The crown has to angle out.
body: <circle cx="24" cy="26" r="16" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="47" y="25.5" width="12" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="currentColor" transform="rotate(-45 53 29)"/><circle cx="40" cy="42" r="16" fill="#FF4D06"/><path d="M40 42 31 33" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

name: Bubble check
note: Bubble stopwatch with Ring check standing in for the dial.
body: <circle cx="25" cy="26" r="15.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="6"/><path d="M17.25 26 22.68 31.43 32.75 20.58" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="5.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="40" cy="42" r="16" fill="#FF4D06"/>

name: Bubble four
note: Bubble stopwatch with the 4 set into the front bubble.
body: <rect x="20" y="5" width="8" height="8" rx="4" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="24" cy="26" r="16" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M24 26 35 20" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="40" cy="42" r="16" fill="#FF4D06"/><path d="M44 32 44 52M44 32 32 46 50 46" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

name: Tally four
note: IIII. The four a clock dial uses and the way you tally at once.
body: <rect x="6" y="15" width="7" height="34" rx="3.5" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="21" y="15" width="7" height="34" rx="3.5" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="36" y="15" width="7" height="34" rx="3.5" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="51" y="15" width="7" height="34" rx="3.5" fill="#FF4D06"/>

name: Four o clock
note: The hand resting on the four. A quiet way to carry the number.
body: <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="7"/><path d="M32 32 42.4 38" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

name: Numeral IV
note: The Roman four drawn as two rounded strokes.
body: <rect x="14" y="16" width="8" height="32" rx="4" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M28 16 37 48 46 16" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

name: Wave
note: The flow symbol. One crest up and one down.
body: <path d="M10 32A11 8 0 0 1 32 32" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M32 32A11 8 0 0 0 54 32" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>

name: Pulse
note: The tracking line. Flat until something happens.
body: <path d="M10 32H24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M24 32 30 17 38 47 44 32" fill="none" stroke="#FF4D06" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M44 32H54" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>

name: Map pin
note: The location indicator the site puts on its maps.
